meta.title: 7年模特经验总结的笑容练习法！
meta.title_en: 7 Years of Modeling: The Smile You Can Train
meta.topic: 表情管理 · 笑容练习

scenes.title_cn: 发力点：苹果肌向上发力
scenes.title_en: Power Point: Cheek Apples Push Up
scenes.context: 很多老婆说笑起来有感染力，但镜头一转就僵。七年模特经验证明笑容真的可以练出来。首先要找到发力点：不是嘴角使劲发力，而是苹果肌向上发力，带动嘴角自然提上来，笑起来不会横向显脸大。语域：模特教学，方法讲解。
sentences: 七年模特经验下来，我证明笑容真的可以练出来。
After seven years of modeling, I can prove a smile really can be trained.
can be trained（可以练出来）
不是嘴角使劲发力，而是苹果肌向上发力。
Don't force the mouth corners — let your cheek apples push upward.
cheek apples（苹果肌）
带动嘴角自然提上来，就不会横向显脸大。
Lifting the corners naturally stops the face from looking wider.
look wider（显脸大）
paraphrase: 发力点 → power point / where to engage
苹果肌 → cheek apples / cheekbones area
scenes.speak: After seven years of modeling, I can prove a smile really can be trained. Don't force the mouth corners — let your cheek apples push upward. Lifting the corners naturally stops the face from looking wider.

scenes.title_cn: 嘴唇放松 + 眼神搭配
scenes.title_en: Relax the Lips and Pair With the Gaze
scenes.context: 嘴唇一定要放松，用力就会很僵硬很不好看。然后搭配眼神发力：眼睛微微眯，找到卧蚕的发力点，就是那种想看清东西的感觉。语域：模特教学，细节讲解。
sentences: 嘴唇一定要放松，你用力就会很僵硬。
Keep the lips relaxed — forcing them looks stiff.
forcing them（用力）
然后搭配眼神发力。
Then pair it with gaze engagement.
gaze engagement（眼神发力）
找到卧蚕的发力点，像想看清东西的感觉。
Find the aegyo-sal power point — like trying to see something clearly.
aegyo-sal（卧蚕）
paraphrase: 嘴唇放松 → relax the lips / keep the lips soft
scenes.speak: Keep the lips relaxed — forcing them looks stiff. Then pair it with gaze engagement. Find the aegyo-sal power point — like trying to see something clearly.

scenes.context: 放肆大笑：发「嗨」音，嘴角弧度自然漂亮。大笑时用「嗨」音带动嘴型。语域：模特教学，练法口令。
sentences: 放肆大笑，发「嗨」音。
For a big open laugh, say 'hi'.
a big open laugh（放肆大笑）
嘴角弧度自然漂亮。
The corner curve turns out naturally pretty.
naturally pretty（自然漂亮）
牙齿露出来，笑容更有感染力。
Show the teeth — the smile becomes more contagious.
contagious（有感染力）
paraphrase: 放肆大笑 → big open laugh / laugh out loud
big open laugh · laugh out loud
scenes.speak: For a big open laugh, say 'hi'. The corner curve turns out naturally pretty. Show the teeth — the smile becomes more contagious.

scenes.context: 抬眉笑：眉毛压住眼神才空洞，轻抬眉眼舒展。双拳按住嘴角肌肉，打圈按摩30秒再练习，嘴角肌肉就放松了。语域：模特教学，练习法收尾。
sentences: 抬眉笑：眉毛压住眼神才空洞。
Brow-lift smile: flat brows empty the gaze.
flat brows empty the gaze（眉毛压住眼神空洞）
轻抬眉眼，舒展有神。
A slight brow lift opens and brightens the eyes.
brightens the eyes（有神）
双拳按住嘴角肌肉，打圈按摩30秒再练习。
Press the mouth corners with both fists and massage in circles for 30 seconds.
massage in circles（打圈按摩）
paraphrase: 抬眉笑 → brow-lift smile / lift the brows and smile
打圈按摩 → massage in circles / circular massage
scenes.speak: Brow-lift smile: flat brows empty the gaze. A slight brow lift opens and brightens the eyes. Press the mouth corners with both fists and massage in circles for 30 seconds.

practice: Don't force the mouth corners — let your cheek apples push upward.
Keep the lips relaxed — forcing them looks stiff.
For a big open laugh, say 'hi' and show the teeth.
Press the mouth corners and massage in circles for 30 seconds.
pitfalls: Use the apple muscle to smile.
Let your cheek apples push upward.
「嘴角」用 mouth corners，不是 the mouth。
For a big open laugh, say 'hi'.
「眉毛压住眼神」用 flat brows empty the gaze。
shifts: 用 cheek apples（苹果肌）、push upward（向上发力）、corner curve（嘴角弧度）
用 gaze engagement（眼神发力）、aegyo-sal（卧蚕）、flat brows（平眉）
用 contagious（有感染力）、naturally pretty（自然漂亮）、brightens the eyes（有神）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：张张出篇→张张出片、苹果即→苹果肌、卧蚕、嗨音、抬眉、双拳按嘴角、打圈按摩、僵硬、感染力、显脸大等。
